newsitem.title: USA: IVAX says to present data to FDA on paxene.
newsitem.headline: IVAX says to present data to FDA on paxene.

text.p: IVAX Corp said Tuesday it will present clinical data regarding its product, called paxene, for treating Kaposi's sarcoma to the U.S. Food and Drug Adminstration's oncology drugs advisory committee.
Earlier this year, IVAX and NaPro BioTherapeutics Inc submitted a new drug application to FDA seeking approval to manufacture and market Paxene in the U.S.
Kaposi's sarcoma is a cancer related to the immunocompromised state that accompanies AIDS.

As previously announced, IVAX and NaPro are strategic partners in the development, manufacture and marketing of the compound paclitaxel -- which IVAX calls Paxene under its registered trade name -- in the U.S., Europe and certain other world markets.
